import requests, numpy as np, collections, json
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Sequences: all reviewed human TAS2R paralogs
fa=requests.get('https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream',
    params={'query':'(gene:TAS2R*) AND (organism_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true)','format':'fasta'},timeout=120).text
T2R={}
for blk in fa.split('>')[1:]:
    h,*rest=blk.split('\n'); gn=[t[3:] for t in h.split() if t.startswith('GN=')]
    T2R[gn[0] if gn else h.split('|')[1]]=''.join(rest)
S38=T2R['TAS2R38']; others=sorted(k for k in T2R if k!='TAS2R38')
print(f'{len(T2R)} reviewed human TAS2R sequences; TAS2R38 length {len(S38)}')

# --- row-vectorised affine Needleman-Wunsch (BLOSUM62, open -11 extend -1) ---
_o='ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV'
_m=np.array([[4,-1,-2,-2,0,-1,-1,0,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-1,1,0,-3,-2,0],[-1,5,0,-2,-3,1,0,-2,0,-3,-2,2,-1,-3,-2,-1,-1,-3,-2,-3],[-2,0,6,1,-3,0,0,0,1,-3,-3,0,-2,-3,-2,1,0,-4,-2,-3],[-2,-2,1,6,-3,0,2,-1,-1,-3,-4,-1,-3,-3,-1,0,-1,-4,-3,-3],[0,-3,-3,-3,9,-3,-4,-3,-3,-1,-1,-3,-1,-2,-3,-1,-1,-2,-2,-1],[-1,1,0,0,-3,5,2,-2,0,-3,-2,1,0,-3,-1,0,-1,-2,-1,-2],[-1,0,0,2,-4,2,5,-2,0,-3,-3,1,-2,-3,-1,0,-1,-3,-2,-2],[0,-2,0,-1,-3,-2,-2,6,-2,-4,-4,-2,-3,-3,-2,0,-2,-2,-3,-3],[-2,0,1,-1,-3,0,0,-2,8,-3,-3,-1,-2,-1,-2,-1,-2,-2,2,-3],[-1,-3,-3,-3,-1,-3,-3,-4,-3,4,2,-3,1,0,-3,-2,-1,-3,-1,3],[-1,-2,-3,-4,-1,-2,-3,-4,-3,2,4,-2,2,0,-3,-2,-1,-2,-1,1],[-1,2,0,-1,-3,1,1,-2,-1,-3,-2,5,-1,-3,-1,0,-1,-3,-2,-2],[-1,-1,-2,-3,-1,0,-2,-3,-2,1,2,-1,5,0,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,1],[-2,-3,-3,-3,-2,-3,-3,-3,-1,0,0,-3,0,6,-4,-2,-2,1,3,-1],[-1,-2,-2,-1,-3,-1,-1,-2,-2,-3,-3,-1,-2,-4,7,-1,-1,-4,-3,-2],[1,-1,1,0,-1,0,0,0,-1,-2,-2,0,-1,-2,-1,4,1,-3,-2,-2],[0,-1,0,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-1,1,5,-2,-2,0],[-3,-3,-4,-4,-2,-2,-3,-2,-2,-3,-2,-3,-1,1,-4,-3,-2,11,2,-3],[-2,-2,-2,-3,-2,-1,-2,-3,2,-1,-1,-2,-1,3,-3,-2,-2,2,7,-1],[0,-3,-3,-3,-1,-2,-2,-3,-3,3,1,-2,1,-1,-2,-2,0,-3,-1,4]],float)
IDX={c:i for i,c in enumerate(_o)}
enc=lambda s: np.array([IDX.get(c,0) for c in s])
NEG=-1e9; G=-11.; E=-1.
def nw(s1,s2):
    a,b=enc(s1),enc(s2); n,m=len(a),len(b); SUB=_m[np.ix_(a,b)]
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); M[0,0]=0.
    j=np.arange(1,m+1); Iy[0,1:]=G+E*(j-1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        prev=np.maximum(np.maximum(M[i-1,:-1],Ix[i-1,:-1]),Iy[i-1,:-1])
        M[i,1:]=prev+SUB[i-1]
        Ix[i,1:]=np.maximum(np.maximum(M[i-1,1:]+G,Iy[i-1,1:]+G),Ix[i-1,1:]+E)
        Ix[i,0]=G+E*(i-1)
        V=np.maximum(M[i,:m],Ix[i,:m])+G          # V[k] for k=0..m-1
        C=V-E*np.arange(m); R=np.maximum.accumulate(C)
        Iy[i,1:]=E*np.arange(m)+R
    # traceback, recomputing pointers
    i,jj=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]])); out={}
    while i>0 and jj>0:
        if st==0:
            out[i]=s2[jj-1]
            st=int(np.argmax([M[i-1,jj-1],Ix[i-1,jj-1],Iy[i-1,jj-1]])); i-=1; jj-=1
        elif st==1:
            st=int(np.argmax([M[i-1,jj]+G,Ix[i-1,jj]+E,Iy[i-1,jj]+G])); i-=1
        else:
            st=int(np.argmax([M[i,jj-1]+G,Ix[i,jj-1]+G,Iy[i,jj-1]+E])); jj-=1
    return out

cons=collections.defaultdict(list); ident={}
for k in others:
    mp=nw(S38,T2R[k])
    col=[1 if mp.get(p)==S38[p-1] else 0 for p in range(1,len(S38)+1)]
    ident[k]=np.mean(col)
    for p,v in zip(range(1,len(S38)+1),col): cons[p].append(v)
consv={p:float(np.mean(v)) for p,v in cons.items()}
print('global identity to TAS2R38, range %.3f (%s) to %.3f (%s)'%(min(ident.values()),min(ident,key=ident.get),max(ident.values()),max(ident,key=ident.get)))

# Sets computed earlier in this job (recorded in provenance/tas2r38_pocket_mapping_results.md)
ORTHO=[71,74,86,92,95,96,99,103,185,189,194,197,198,201,256,260,263,266,270,279,282,283,285,286]
INTRA=[51,53,54,113,117,118,120,216,219,220,240,241,242,244,245,248,249,252,293,297,300,301,302,303,305]
INTRA=[p for p in INTRA if p<=len(S38)]
rest=[p for p in range(1,len(S38)+1) if p not in ORTHO and p not in INTRA and 45<=p<=310]
co=[consv[p] for p in ORTHO]; ci=[consv[p] for p in INTRA]; bg=[consv[p] for p in rest]
def cliffs(a,b):
    a=np.asarray(a);b=np.asarray(b);return float(np.sign(a[:,None]-b[None,:]).sum()/(len(a)*len(b)))
print('='*96)
print('F. PARALOG CONSERVATION BY SITE (fraction of the 27 other human TAS2Rs identical to TAS2R38)')
print('='*96)
for lab,v in [('orthosteric-site equivalents',co),('intracellular-site cavity lining',ci),('rest of residues 45-310',bg)]:
    print(f'  {lab:<34} n={len(v):<4} mean {np.mean(v):.3f}  median {np.median(v):.3f}  IQR {np.percentile(v,25):.3f}-{np.percentile(v,75):.3f}')
for lab,a,b in [('ortho vs rest',co,bg),('intra vs rest',ci,bg),('intra vs ortho',ci,co)]:
    u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative='two-sided')
    print(f'  {lab:<16} Mann-Whitney U={u:>7.0f}  p={p:.2e}  Cliff delta={cliffs(a,b):+.3f}')
print('  residues of interest:')
for q in [49,99,100,103,197,201,255,259,262,264,296]:
    tag='ORTHO' if q in ORTHO else ('INTRA' if q in INTRA else '-')
    print(f'    {S38[q-1]}{q:<4} paralog identity {consv[q]:.2f}   site:{tag}')
json.dump({'consv':consv,'ident':ident,'ORTHO':ORTHO,'INTRA':INTRA},open('/tmp/cons.json','w'))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
dat=[co,ci,bg]; labs=['orthosteric\nsite equivalents','intracellular\nsite cavity','rest of\nresidues 45-310']
bp=ax[0].boxplot(dat,labels=labs,widths=.55,patch_artist=True,showfliers=False)
for b,c in zip(bp['boxes'],['#4a7fb5','#c2663a','#b9bec4']): b.set_facecolor(c); b.set_alpha(.75)
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for i,d in enumerate(dat): ax[0].scatter(rng.normal(i+1,.07,len(d)),d,s=13,color='#222',alpha=.5,zorder=3)
ax[0].set_ylabel('fraction of 27 human TAS2R paralogs\nidentical to TAS2R38')
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(ci,co,alternative='two-sided')
ax[0].set_title(f'Paralog conservation by site\nintracellular vs orthosteric p = {p:.1e}',fontsize=10)
ks=sorted(consv); ax[1].plot(ks,[consv[k] for k in ks],color='#b9bec4',lw=.9)
ax[1].scatter(ORTHO,[consv[p_] for p_ in ORTHO],color='#4a7fb5',s=26,label='orthosteric site',zorder=3)
ax[1].scatter(INTRA,[consv[p_] for p_ in INTRA],color='#c2663a',s=26,label='intracellular site',zorder=3)
for q in [49,262,296]:
    ax[1].scatter(q,consv[q],color='#d62728',marker='D',s=48,zorder=4)
    ax[1].annotate(f'{S38[q-1]}{q}',(q,consv[q]),textcoords='offset points',xytext=(2,7),fontsize=8,color='#d62728')
for q in [99,103,197,201,264]:
    ax[1].annotate(f'{S38[q-1]}{q}',(q,consv[q]),textcoords='offset points',xytext=(2,-12),fontsize=8,color='#1f4e79')
ax[1].set_xlabel('TAS2R38 residue number'); ax[1].set_ylabel('paralog identity')
ax[1].set_title('Conservation along the TAS2R38 sequence',fontsize=10); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
